stem: A nurse manager wants team members to speak up about safety concerns, ask questions, and admit mistakes without fear of retaliation. Which team condition is the manager trying to strengthen?
rationale: AHRQ describes psychological safety as a shared belief that the work environment is safe for open dialogue about difficult situations and processes, including speaking up about safety concerns without fear of retribution.
educational_objective: Recognize psychological safety as a condition that supports speaking up about patient safety.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
source_locator: Definition—safe environment for open dialogue and speaking up about difficult situations and safety concerns
source_claim_supported: Psychological safety supports open dialogue and speaking up without fear of retribution.
correction_summary: Removed outcome overclaims and tested the AHRQ-defined construct directly.
audit_findings: Stem maps directly to the definition.
Independent second pass found one best answer.
